title: Automated whole-tooth bounding-box annotation
label_type: No machine-generated candidate boxes. Existing YOLO/COCO/VOC files remain empty placeholders from Stage 3A/3B.

candidate_vs_verified.note: Do not treat empty files as ground truth. Human drawing in CVAT/Label Studio is required (Stage 3C stop + Stage 3D after humans annotate).

method_decision.action: Did not fabricate boxes. Did not convert lesion XML. Did not download models. Did not search the internet.

inspected.keras_weights_present: ICDAS classification only (MobileNetV3/CBAM .keras) — not a tooth localizer
inspected.why_ultralytics_not_used: No local tooth-detection checkpoint. Generic COCO YOLO would invent non-tooth boxes and would require downloading weights.
inspected.why_opencv_not_used: Contour/threshold blobs are not whole-tooth identity and would fabricate boxes.
inspected.why_lesion_xml_not_used: d/D boxes are caries lesions, not teeth.

format_status.yolo: 420 empty txt files retained; structurally valid as zero-object labels; not tooth GT
format_status.pascal_voc: size-only XML from Stage 3A/3B; no tooth objects

visualizations: not generated (no boxes to overlay; originals not copied)
next_stage: Human annotation in CVAT/Label Studio using Stage 3B project, then Stage 3D QC/finalization
